title: At most n = m + 1 coordinates lie within d(x)/√(n + 1) of a cube centre (parent step 5)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a, x ∈ ℝ^P and b ∈ ℤ^P. Let L*(a) := {w ∈ ℝ^P : there is a finite set s of coordinate indices with |s| ≥ m + 2 and w_i − a_i ∈ ℤ for all i ∈ s} and d := infDist(x, L*(a)) (Metric.infDist, which is 0 for the empty set). Then at most m + 1 indices i satisfy |x_i − b_i − a_i| < d/√(m + 2).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a x : Euclid P) (b : Fin P → ℤ), (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => |x i - b i - a i| < infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} / Real.sqrt (m + 2))).card ≤ m + 1
